701381.ov: Nana, a taxi driver, unknowingly helps DD, a notorious criminal. In order to return the favor, DD forces him to join his gang, but Mama, a smart police officer, ruins his plan.

1179461.ov: Police Commissioner Krishnakant Deshmukh and his family are very religious and god fearing. His son Kapil is in love with Swati and despite their horoscopes not matching, he marries her, much to the annoyance of his parents. Days pass by but Swati can't bear a child.

1576389.ov: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and…

1653445.ov: The story follows Raghav, a troubled artist living in isolation after personal loss and betrayal. His life gradually intertwines with several other wounded souls, each carrying their own struggles and emotions.

1664325.ov: Arjun and Supriya love each other and marry against their families' wishes. Suddenly, Arjun dies in an accident. While Supriya's boss Raghav reveals he killed Arjun. Supriya's quest to get Arjun justice forms the crux of the story.

1716933.ov: The story follows a woman from the Banjara community who battles bureaucratic corruption and a political nexus to secure fair compensation for land acquired by the government

tv312005.ov: Every Holi in Devtali, a death is blamed on the mythical demon, Shankasur. Inspector Vishwas investigates the latest death, only to uncover an unsettling truth about the alleged divine punishment.

tv205125.ov: Rang Maza Vegla is an Indian Marathi soap opera that airs on Star Pravah. It premiered on 30 October 2019. It is an official remake of Malayalam TV series Karuthamuthu
